assumptions: The geometric R is a baseline study, not a completed multiple-viewpoint identity.
brief.audience: People observing and improving their own exercise movement.
avoid: A decorative grid unrelated to source geometry
brief.name: Reprism

philosophies.statement: Make movement legible without visual noise.
Retain a recognizable repetition and direction motif.
Read the same movement from several viewpoints.

brief.purpose: Make exercise motion observable and understandable through tracking and replay.

rules.statement: Derive the geometric study from one base unit.
Use equal stem and perpendicular diagonal widths.
Explore counter geometry derived from transformed views of one source curve.

brief.typography: Manrope 700 in the archived wordmark study; not a generic skill default.

rationale.check: Check stroke equality numerically; inspect counter and joins at 28/32/40px.
rationale.observable_result: An uncluttered R with a deliberate counter.
rationale.rule: Use shared circular geometry and constant stroke weight.

rationale.check: Inspect the silhouette in one color; do not assume the arrow alone communicates repeated cycles.
rationale.observable_result: One directional silhouette rather than a separately attached arrow.
rationale.rule: Join the diagonal band to an integrated directional terminal.

rationale.check: A later recipe must show actual shared-source projection before this mapping can be marked implemented.
rationale.observable_result: Not implemented in this baseline study.
rationale.rule: Derive counter geometry from transformed views of one source curve.
